response.answer: 시뮬레이션 공정 데이터 기준으로 42개 행을 조회했습니다.
response.sql: WITH observations AS (SELECT interval_end, area, AVG(yield_percent) AS yield_percent FROM fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10 WHERE fab_id = 'fab10' AND interval_end >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-06 00:00:00+09:00' AND interval_end < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-13 00:00:00+09:00' GROUP BY interval_end, area) SELECT date_trunc('day', interval_end AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS observed_at, area, AVG(yield_percent) AS yield_percent, COUNT(*) AS observation_count, MIN(interval_end) AS first_observed_at, MAX(interval_end) AS last_observed_at FROM observations GROUP BY date_trunc('day', interval_end AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), area ORDER BY observed_at ASC, area
limitations: 조회값은 생성된 시뮬레이션 공정 데이터이며 실제 공장 실측값이 아닙니다.
집계는 선택한 snapshot/event의 시간과 행 단위를 기준으로 합니다.
시각·날짜는 Asia/Seoul(KST), 집계 기준은 interval_end(구간 종료 시각)입니다.
조회 기간은 KST 2026-09-06 이상 2026-09-13 미만입니다.
기간별 WIP·대기시간·수율·가동률은 관측 구간의 비가중 산술평균입니다. LOT 가중평균이나 기간 누적 WIP가 아닙니다. 완료/투입 LOT·down/PM 시간은 구간 합계입니다.

response.sql: WITH observations AS (SELECT interval_end, area, AVG(avg_queue_minutes) AS avg_queue_minutes, SUM(wip_lots) AS wip_lots, AVG(utilization_percent) AS utilization_percent, SUM(down_minutes) AS down_minutes, SUM(pm_minutes) AS pm_minutes, SUM(lot_completions) AS lot_completions, AVG(bottleneck_score) AS bottleneck_score FROM fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10 WHERE fab_id = 'fab10' AND area IN ('etch') AND interval_end > (SELECT MAX(interval_end) FROM fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10) - INTERVAL '168 hours' AND interval_end <= (SELECT MAX(interval_end) FROM fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10) GROUP BY interval_end, area) SELECT date_trunc('day', interval_end AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS observed_at, area, AVG(avg_queue_minutes) AS avg_queue_minutes, AVG(wip_lots) AS wip_lots, AVG(utilization_percent) AS utilization_percent, SUM(down_minutes) AS down_minutes, SUM(pm_minutes) AS pm_minutes, SUM(lot_completions) AS lot_completions, AVG(bottleneck_score) AS bottleneck_score, COUNT(*) AS observation_count, MIN(interval_end) AS first_observed_at, MAX(interval_end) AS last_observed_at FROM observations GROUP BY date_trunc('day', interval_end AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), area ORDER BY observed_at ASC, area
limitations: 조회값은 생성된 시뮬레이션 공정 데이터이며 실제 공장 실측값이 아닙니다.
